<h1>Location, When &amp; How to Come?</h1></div>

				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="365" height="365" src="https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/fish-h365.png" alt="" title="" srcset="https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/fish-h365.png 365w, https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/fish-h365-150x150.png 150w, https://mazavaloha-resort.com/wp-content/uploads/fish-h365-300x300.png 300w" sizes="(max-width: 365px) 100vw, 365px" class="wp-image-205014" /></span>

				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Ideal Location of Mazava Loha Resort</strong></span></h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Perfectly situated at the heart of the Emerald Sea, facing the famous spot known as &#8220;la piscine,&#8221; Mazava Loha Resort offers an exclusive experience for water sports enthusiasts. Our strategic location provides quick access to the beaches, islands, and unparalleled spots of this fabulous lagoon, making our resort the ultimate choice for kiteboarding, windsurfing, wingfoiling, foiling, as well as wave riders, freestylers, and Big Air enthusiasts.</p>
<p>Discover the unparalleled comfort of our accommodations, whether it&#8217;s wooden bungalows nestled in the forest or suites with breathtaking sea views. Every detail has been carefully crafted to offer a unique experience where luxury and adventure harmoniously blend. Book now to immerse yourself in the essence of the Emerald Sea, amidst winds, waves, and thrilling sensations.</p></div>
